as_told.title: Jailbroken OpenAI answer: working hand in hand with aliens

plain: A version of an artificial intelligence system from OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, is said to have been "jailbroken", meaning tricked into ignoring its built-in rules, and then asked what OpenAI does not want people to know. According to Jesse Michels, who relays it from a researcher named Deep Prasad, the answer was that "we have been working hand in hand with aliens for the last 10 years", and in a second telling it added, "We've been in communication with them."
